findings.text: No. A fever didn't come in layers a fortnight apart, or keep to one road and leave the King's road clean beside it.
findings.pattern: Pattern 2 fragment pivot / cluster rule (same 'No.' shape repeated at L25 four lines later)
findings.deletionTest: She had held on to that one since Millhaven without saying it aloud ... A fever didn't come in layers a fortnight apart. The rebuttal survives without the 'No.' beat.
findings.reason: The 'No.' fragment is the same self-rebuttal pivot that opens L25 ('No. Slower.'); two in one thought-run is the pattern repeating. The fever sentence itself is a binary diagnostic and stays.
findings.suggestedFix: But a fever didn't come in layers a fortnight apart, or keep to one road and leave the King's road clean beside it.

findings.text: She reached up, took Jaina under the arms and lifted her down, as she had at every stop since the sick village, without being asked and without making anything of it.

findings.deletionTest: She reached up, took Jaina under the arms and lifted her down, as she had at every stop since the sick village. Survives and lands harder; 'every stop' already carries the habit.

findings.text: Jaina had no wish to tell her about the bracken, the fence, the female humming by the hut; it wouldn't have changed a thing Sylvanas had read off him.
findings.pattern: Pattern 7 chained negation (Sylvanas didn't ask. / had no wish / wouldn't have changed)
findings.deletionTest: Cut the negated desire and the negated consequence: Jaina kept the memory to herself. The plan constraint (memory stays inside Jaina) survives intact.
findings.reason: Three negations in a row build a hallway to a non-event; the second clause also speculates about what Sylvanas read, which Jaina cannot know.
findings.suggestedFix: Jaina kept the bracken, the fence and the female humming by the hut to herself.
